
```{python}
import pandas as pd
import os

dfs = []

for file in os.listdir("results/dual_regression"):
    if file.endswith(".csv"):
        df = pd.read_csv("results/dual_regression/" + file)
        df["dataset"] = file.replace(".csv", "")
        dfs.append(df)

all_dr = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
all_dr["scan_ID"] = range(1, len(all_dr) + 1)

all_dr

```

```{python}
components = [f"comp{i}" for i in range(1, 19)]

a = 0.2

for dataset in all_dr["dataset"].unique():
    df = all_dr[all_dr["dataset"] == dataset]
    
    count = (df[components] < a).sum().sum()
    total = df[components].size
    percentage = count / total * 100
    
    print(dataset, count, percentage)

```

```{python}
all_dr["n_above_threshold"] = (all_dr[components] < a).sum(axis=1)

all_dr[["scan_ID", "dataset", "n_above_threshold"]].sort_values(
    "n_above_threshold", ascending=False
)

all_dr["max_value"] = all_dr[components].max(axis=1)

all_dr[["scan_ID", "dataset", "max_value"]].sort_values(
    "max_value", ascending=False
)

all_dr[["scan_ID", "dataset", "n_above_threshold", "max_value"]].sort_values(
    ["n_above_threshold", "max_value"], ascending=False
)

```
